comments.author: epicyclic
comments.text: OP here — posting this mostly because the gear-ratio reconstruction argument is the best kind of detective story: you have corroded fragments, tooth counts you can only estimate from X-ray slices, and the constraint that whatever ratios you propose must land on astronomically meaningful periods. The interplay between 'what the metal allows' and 'what the sky requires' is the whole game. Happy to answer questions, though the thread seems quiet so far.
